extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question. The 'Date' column had one invalid value ('not-a-date'), which was set to missing. The 'Price' column stored values as text (e.g., '$6.00'), which was safely converted to numbers. Revenue was incorrect in 3 rows (e.g., 140000 instead of 1400), so it was recomputed as Quantity * Price. Three rows had negative Quantity (-5, -1, -7), which violates the rule that Quantity must be at least 1; these rows were excluded. After these fixes, the total units sold per region were calculated. Note: One row had an invalid date but was not removed entirely because the question does not depend on dates.
